description: This file defines the ParticipantId struct, including its roles, equality comparison, and extension methods for role checks and selection within collections, used in Orleans transaction management.

classes.name: ParticipantId
classes.description: Immutable struct representing a participant in a transaction, with properties for name, reference, and supported roles, and an internal comparer class.

classes.name: ParticipantId.IdComparer
classes.description: Sealed class implementing IEqualityComparer for ParticipantId, providing custom equality and hash code logic.

classes.name: ParticipantRoleExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for role support checks and collection filtering for ParticipantId instances.

methods.name: ParticipantId.ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ParticipantId, including name and reference.

methods.name: ParticipantRoleExtensions.SupportsRoles
methods.description: Checks if a participant supports a specific role.

methods.name: ParticipantRoleExtensions.IsResource
methods.description: Determines if a participant has the Resource role.

methods.name: ParticipantRoleExtensions.IsManager
methods.description: Determines if a participant has the Manager role.

methods.name: ParticipantRoleExtensions.IsPriorityManager
methods.description: Determines if a participant has the PriorityManager role.

methods.name: ParticipantRoleExtensions.SelectResources
methods.description: Filters a collection of participant-access pairs to only resources.

methods.name: ParticipantRoleExtensions.SelectManagers
methods.description: Filters a collection of participant-access pairs to only managers.

methods.name: ParticipantRoleExtensions.SelectPriorityManagers
methods.description: Filters a collection of participants to only priority managers.
